assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are maintainer-defined provisional constraints derived from official text extents; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All design layers, metrics, figures, PDFs and HTML must be recalculated when cleared official polygons arrive. Content scoring is not blocked solely by organizer data gaps.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire protection, heritage buffers and engineering constraints are not in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, setback, demolition or engineering conclusion may be treated as statutory. Proposal uses conceptual wording only.

assumptions.statement: Retain/renovate/demolish/new-build labels in this package are conceptual design methods, not parcel-level surveyed conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Professional teams must reclassify after ownership, building survey and control conditions are available.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, developer commons and scenario open days are proposed operation mechanisms, not confirmed government programmes or funded commitments.
assumptions.impact: Treat as reference schemes for operators and professional teams to deepen.
